alate: Head capsule brownish yellow, pronotum yellow, tibiae pale yellow. Head capsule nearly circular, frontal region slightly concave, dorsal margin of the head slightly raised. Fontanelle dot-like; compound eyes nearly circular, their short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head; ocelli oval, long diameter about twice the ocellus–compound eye distance. Antennae 17 segments in total. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly incised in the middle, posterior margin with a distinct incision in the middle. Forewing narrow and long, about 3.5 times as long as wide, cubital vein with 10–11 branches.
